## Summary

Describe the change and its purpose. Include stable PTO requirement IDs and
source links for normative changes.

## Architecture impact

Describe visible state, legality, results, ordering, faults, profile scope, and intentionally unspecified behavior.
Write `None` for non-normative changes.

## Known gaps

List known gaps, assumptions, ASLRef limitations, and follow-up architecture decisions.

Pull requests have no required validation checks or approvals. The release
manager runs the complete ASLRef suite separately through
`scripts/validate-release` before publishing a release.
